description: Proposed descriptive names for functions and globals. Not original symbols and not yet applied to src/; see docs/SYSTEMS.md. "curated" is the reviewed priority set, "extended" is mechanical class-method, quest-opcode and asset-loader names.

sources.newserv: newserv, the public PSO server project (github.com/fuzziqersoftware/newserv), commit 8a75f6ef: notes/handler-tables.txt, notes/dat-constructor-tables.txt, src/CommandFormats.hh, src/QuestScript.cc, src/PSOGCObjectGraph.cc, system/client-functions (2OPF columns)
sources.image: structure of the decoded executable: vtables, class-name strings, tables, call graph, SDK version banners and error strings

names.name: vmu_init

names.name: game_main
names.evidence: called by SHC crt startup 0x8c340848; runs game_init then loops over g_game_mode_table[mode]{init,frame,exit} until mode 0, then game_shutdown and spins forever

names.name: game_init
names.evidence: called once by game_main before the mode loop; references "$Date: 01/11/15 20:51 $ $Revision: 45 $"; loads S18all04.fon, particleentry.dat, effect_nt, ha_u032_kage.pvm, manatee.drv, sets video mode by cable type (0x31/0x38/0x2007a)

names.name: game_shutdown
names.evidence: called by game_main after the mode loop exits; calls the shutdown_* routines of every subsystem (repo already names it shutdown_game)

names.name: set_initial_game_mode
names.evidence: called by game_init; sets current/f08/f0c to 1 (SEGA logo mode) or 0x13 depending on g_8c41cb38 (set by game_init from cable type)

names.name: request_game_mode
names.evidence: sets g_game_mode_state.next=a0 and .exit_request=1 (game_main then switches mode); 37 callers

names.name: get_game_mode
names.evidence: returns g_game_mode_state.current (0x8c41cb00); 83 callers
